name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (execute / summon_spell_cast). Accurately names the function's job: run the 召喚系 (summon) spell cinematic and gameplay effect for spell ids 0x20-0x23. No Ghidra address residue. The 0x20-0x23 are the four summon spell IDs (within the valid spell ID range 00h-23h), a meaningful domain range, not address residue.
purpose: Play the full multi-phase cinematic for a 召喚系 (summon) spell (ids 0x20 熾天使 / 0x21 風妖精 / 0x22 破壞神 / 0x23 暗邪鬼) and then apply that summon's gameplay effect to the targets.
logic_summary: Frees + reloads game-state/scene buffers, reads the caster tile attribute (+6 byte = background variant), loads TAI/BG/FIGANI/FDOTHER resources and the per-summon SFX bank, then runs phases: caster cast pose (intro-zoom + figani loop), 8-frame pose-A slide-in, 9-frame summon-sprite slide-out, optional extra blit (0x21/0x22), per-pose-frame summon animation with per-summon SFX hooks, optional 11-frame strobe with palette interpolation (0x20/0x23), then frees temp buffers, re-allocs the large game-state buffer + battle scene snapshot, runs a 0x29-step palette fade-in, and finally dispatches the spell-id-specific gameplay effect (0x20 attack damage; 0x21 clear status bytes +0x25..+0x27 then group HP heal 800; 0x22 AP+DP+speed boosts; 0x23 three status-inflict casts spell 0x1A/0x16/0x1B sprite 0x25/0x27/0x26). Per-summon palette R/G/B and SFX-bank-index are 4-byte tables byte-indexed by spell_id-0x20, copied to local dwords (mirroring the binary's stack copies).
signature: void fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast(uint32 caster_idx, uint32 spell_id, uint32 n_targets, int target_id_array)

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr of the casting unit; used as &runtime_char_array[caster_idx] to read pos_x/pos_y/portrait_id and passed to the cast/effect helpers.
params.reason: Accurate; matches caster runtime-char index usage. No address residue.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Summon spell id 0x20..0x23; selects palette/SFX table entry (spell_id-0x20), the summon sprite (idx spell_id+0x21), and the phase-4/6 + gameplay-effect branches.
params.reason: Accurate; 0x20-0x23 are meaningful spell IDs (domain range), not address residue.

params.name: n_targets
params.semantics: Number of target ids in target_id_array; loop bound for the 0x21 status-clear loop and passed to the damage/heal/boost/inflict helpers.

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Base of the uint8 target-id array (declared int, used as a pointer): indexed ((uint8*)target_id_array)[i] in the 0x21 loop and passed to all Phase-8 effect helpers as the target list. (This already corrects Ghidra's misleading auto-name 'caster_idx' for the 4th param.)
params.reason: Name is accurate and already fixes Ghidra's misleading 'caster_idx' auto-name. Type is int rather than uint8* but type changes are out of scope for this stage (logic verified correct); name itself is correct with no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are entirely via screen/audio side effects and the Phase-8 gameplay mutations on the target units.
